name: SEC EDGAR
measures: Reported annual revenue of 10 public software companies
about: US public companies file audited results with the Securities and Exchange Commission. We add up annual revenue for a fixed group: Salesforce, Adobe, ServiceNow, Workday, Intuit, Autodesk, Oracle, HubSpot, Twilio and MongoDB.
attribution: Data from SEC EDGAR filings. The SEC has not reviewed or endorsed this site or its results.
limitations: We chose this group, so it is a sample of large public companies, not the whole software market.
These companies also sell hardware, cloud and services, especially Oracle.
Fiscal years differ, so each is credited to the calendar year it mostly falls in.
Acquisitions add revenue without new demand.
